sections.title: What exists
sections.content:
One Playwright E2E file (`mobile/tests/app.spec.ts`) — 10 smoke tests covering login, tab navigation, session persistence. **Zero unit tests for any service or business logic.**

---

sections.title: Gap 1: `offline.ts` — Dedup + edge cases
Gap 2: `syncQueue.ts` — Drain guard + partial failure
Gap 3: `milestones.ts` — Award logic
Gap 4: `purchases.ts` — isPro + cancel handling
Gap 5: `context.ts` — `buildCoachContext` edge cases
Gap 6: Missing E2E scenarios
Gap 7: Integration test gaps (no tests exist at all)
Summary
sections.content:
| Layer | Coverage | Critical gaps |
|-------|----------|--------------|
| E2E (Playwright) | ~40% flows | Registration, logout, habit/goal CRUD, offline |
| Unit — services | **0%** | All 7 service files untested |
| Integration | **0%** | No cross-service flow tests |

Highest priority: `offline.ts` dedup logic and `milestones.ts` award-once guard — both have non-obvious correctness requirements that pure E2E can't catch.
